content: Akɑbu u kĩ
u wuu ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Rɑmɔti wɔrɑ
Isirelibɑ kɑ Siriɡibu bɑ kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ yiru ben ɡoo kun ɡoo tɑbu wɔri.
Wɔ̃ɔ itɑse sɔɔ, ye Yosɑfɑti Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko u nɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑ bokon mi,
yerɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko u win bwɑ̃ɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i yɛ̃ mɑ Rɑmɔti ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Gɑlɑdin temɔ yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ bɛsɛɡiɑ? Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ sɑ ǹ ko ye mwɑ Sirin sunɔn nɔmɑn di.
Mɑ u Yosɑfɑti bikiɑ u nɛɛ, kɑɑ kɑ mɑn tɑɑ bi dɑ Rɑmɔtiɔ Gɑlɑdin temɔ? Yosɑfɑti u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ̀ n sɔɔru kpɑ nɑ kpɑwɑ mi. Wunɛn tɔmbu bɑ̀ n seewɑ, nɛɡibɑ mɑɑ seewɑwɑ mi. Mɛyɑ mɑɑ nɛn mɑɑsɔbu.
Sɔmɔ weesuɡibu bɑ nɛɛ,
Akɑbu koo tɑbu di
Mɑ Yosɑfɑti u mɑɑ nɛɛ, nɑ nun kɑnɑmɔ, ɑ ɡinɑ Yinni Gusunɔ bikio ɑ nɔ mɛ u koo nun sɔ̃.

Sɑɑ yerɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko u sɔmɔbu mɛnnɑ nɡe tɔnu nɛɛrun (400) sɑkɑ. Mɑ u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, n doo Rɑmɔtiɔ Gɑlɑdin temɔ n kɑ Siriɡibu tɑbu ko? Nɡe n ku dɑ. Yerɑ sɔmɔ be, bɑ nùn wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑ doo. Yinni Gusunɔ u koo nun ye nɔmu bɛriɑ.
Adɑmɑ Yosɑfɑti u bikiɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔn sɔmɔ ɡoo sɑri mini wìn min di sɑ ko kpĩ su Yinni Gusunɔn ɡere nɔ?

Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko u nɛɛ, Gusunɔn sɔmɔ turowɑ u wɑ̃ɑ mini, wìn min di sɑ ko kpĩ su Yinni Gusunɔn ɡere nɔ. Adɑmɑ nɑ nùn tusɑ. Domi u ku rɑ mɑn ɡɑ̃ɑ ɡeenu sɔ̃. Sɔmɔ win yĩsirɑ Misee Yimilɑn bii. Mɑ Yosɑfɑti u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, sinɑ boko, ɑ ku ɡere mɛ.
Yerɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko wi, u win sɔm kowo ɡɔrɑ u nɛɛ, u doo u Misee Yimilɑn bii wi sokumɑ fuuku.
Mɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko wi, kɑ Yosɑfɑti Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko bɑ ben sinɑ yɑ̃nu doke, ben bɑɑwure u sɔ̃ win sinɑ kitɑrɔ, Sɑmɑrin ɡbɑ̃rɑ kɔnnɔwɔ. Mɑ sɔmɔ be, bɑ wɑ̃ɑ ben wuswɑɑɔ bɑ ɡɑri mɔ̀.
Yerɑ Sedesiɑsi Kenɑɑnɑn bii u sisun kɔbunu sekɑ. Mɑ u nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ, kɔbi yini, yi sɑ̃ɑwɑ yĩreru te tɑ wunɛn dɑm sɔ̃ɔsimɔ mɛ kɑɑ kɑ Siriɡibu ɡo.
Nɡe mɛyɑ sɔmɔ be kpuro, bɑ ɡerumɔ bɑ mɔ̀, ɑ doo Rɑmɔtiɔ Gɑlɑdin temɔ. Kɑɑ nɑsɑrɑ wɑ. Yinni Gusunɔ u koo nun tɔn be nɔmɑ bɛriɑ.
Misee u Akɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ
mɑ u ǹ nɑsɑrɑ wɑsi
Sɔmɔ wi bɑ ɡɔrɑ u bu Misee sokuɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, wee sɔmɔ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi kpuro, bɑ sinɑ boko ɡɑri ɡeɑ ɡeruɑ. Yen sɔ̃, ɑ de wunɛ kɑ ben ɡɑri yi ko tiɑ.
Mɑ Misee u nɛɛ, sere kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn wɑ̃ɑru, ye wi, Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑn sɔ̃ɔwɑ, yerɑ kon ɡere.
Ye Misee u turɑ sinɑ bokon wuswɑɑɔ, sinɑ boko u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, sɑ ko kpĩ su tɑbu dɑ Rɑmɔti Gɑlɑdin temɔ? Nɡe su ku dɑ. Mɑ u nɛɛ, i doo mɛ, i ko i nɑsɑrɑ wɑ. Yinni Gusunɔ u koo nun bu nɔmu bɛriɑ.
Adɑmɑ sinɑ boko u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, nɔn nyewɑ kon nun bɔ̃rusiɑ ɑ sere mɑn ɡem sɔ̃ mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u nun sɔ̃ɔwɑ ɑ ɡere.
Misee u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: nɑ Isirelibɑ wɑ bɑ yɑrinɛ ɡuunu wɔllɔ
bɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɡe yɑ̃ɑ ni nu kun kpɑro mɔ.
Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ, tɔn beni bɑ ǹ kpɑro mɔ.
Ben bɑɑwure u ɡɔsiro u wurɑ yɛnuɔ kɑ ɑlɑfiɑ.

content: Yerɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko u Yosɑfɑti sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ ǹ dɑɑ nun sɔ̃ɔwɑ mɑ u ku rɑ mɑn ɡɑ̃ɑ ɡeenu sɔ̃, sere ɡɑ̃ɑ kɔ̃sunu?
Yerɑ Misee u Akɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑkio, nɑ nùn wɑ u sɔ̃ win sinɑ kitɑru wɔllɔ. Mɑ win tɑbu kowobu bɑ yɔ̃ win nɔm ɡeu kɑ win nɔm dwɑrɔ.
Mɑ u nɛɛ, wɑrɑ u koo Akɑbu nɔni wɔ̃ke u kɑ tɑɑ bi dɑ Rɑmɔtiɔ Gɑlɑdin temɔ, kpɑ u ɡbi mi. Mɑ bɑ yen wesiɑnɔ mɔ̀. Wini ù n ɡeruɑ mɛni, wi, u ɡere mɛ.
Yerɑ hunde ɡɑɑ yɑ yɑrimɑ yɑ yɔ̃rɑ Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ yɑ nɛɛ, kon Akɑbu wi nɔni wɔ̃ke. Yinni Gusunɔ u ye bikiɑ u nɛɛ, ɑmɔnɑ kɑɑ koosinɑ.

Hunde ye, yɑ nɛɛ, kon yɑri kpɑ n du sɔmɔ be sɔɔ, kpɑ n de bu weesu ko bu kɑ sinɑ boko nɔni wɔ̃ke. Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u ye wisɑ u nɛɛ, yɑ wɑ̃, swɑɑ ɡeɑ. Kɑɑ mɑɑ kpĩ ɑ nùn nɔni wɔ̃ke. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑ yɑrio ɑ dɑ ɑ ko mɛ.
Wee tɛ̃, Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ hunde ye, yɑ duɑ sɔmɔ be sɔɔ, bu kɑ nun weesu kuɑ. Yen sɔ̃, ɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ kɔ̃sɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u koo de yu nun deemɑ.
Yerɑ Sedesiɑsi Kenɑɑnɑn bii u susi Miseen bɔkuɔ u nùn bɑɑrɑ so. Mɑ u nɛɛ, dommɑ Yinni Gusunɔn hunde u yɑrɑ nɛn min di u kɑ sere nun ɡɑri kuɑ.
Misee u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, kɑɑ ɡiɑ dɔmɑ te kɑɑ duku dukubu ko, ɑ n kuku yeru kɑsu dirɔ.
Yerɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko u nɛɛ, i Misee mɔɔ i kɑ dɑ Amɔɔ wi u sɑ̃ɑ wuun wiruɡii kɑ mɑɑ Yoɑsi, sinɑ bokon biin mi.
Kpɑ i bu sɔ̃ i nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ nɛ sinɑ boko nɑ ɡeruɑ. Nɑ nɛɛ, bu durɔ wi mɔɔ bu doke pirisɔmwɔ kpɑ bɑ n nùn dĩɑnu kɑ nim wɛ̃ɛmɔ sɑkɑ sɔɔ sere n kɑ wurɑmɑ tɑbu ɡberun di kɑ ɑlɑfiɑ.
Misee u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ̀ n wurɑmɑ kɑ ɑlɑfiɑ, n ǹ Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ mɑn ɡɑri kuɑ. Bɛɛ be i wɑ̃ɑ mini, bɛɛn bɑɑwure u ɡɑri yi swɑɑ suo.
Akɑbun ɡɔɔ
Yenibɑn biru, Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko kɑ Yosɑfɑti, Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko bɑ seewɑ bɑ tɑɑ bi dɑ Rɑmɔtiɔ Gɑlɑdin temɔ.

Yerɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko u Yosɑfɑti sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ kon nɛn yɑ̃nu kɔsi kpɑ n ɡɑnu doke nì sɔɔ bɑ ǹ mɑn tubu. Adɑmɑ wunɛ, ɑ n wunɛn sinɑ yɑ̃nu doke. Mɛsumɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko u kuɑ bu ku kɑ nùn tubu tɑɑ bi sɔɔ.
N deemɑ tɑbu kɛkɛ tɛnɑ kɑ yiruwɑ Sirin sinɑ boko u mɔ ye dumi ɡɑwe. Mɑ u yen wiruɡibu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bu ku rɑɑ ɡoo ɡo mɑ n kun mɔ Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko tɔnɑ.
Sɑɑ ye Sirin tɑbu wiruɡii be, bɑ Yosɑfɑti wɛndɛ kuɑ, yerɑ bɑ nɛɛ, Isirelibɑn sinɑ bokowɑ mi kɑm kɑm. Mɑ bɑ sĩiremɑ win mi, bu nùn wɔri. Adɑmɑ u nɔɔɡiru suɑ u fɑɑbɑ kɑnɑ.
Ye Sirin tɑbu kowo be, bɑ deemɑ n ǹ Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko mi, yerɑ bɑ nùn deri bɑ doonɑ.

Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ durɔ ɡoo u sɛ̃u toomɑ Isirelibɑn mi ɡiɑ u ǹ ɡoo yĩisi. Adɑmɑ ɡɑ nɑ ɡɑ Akɑbu wɔri deedeeru mi wi tɑrɑkpe ɡɑ yɔ̃rɑ. Yerɑ u win tɑbu kɛkɛ swɑɑ sɔ̃ɔsio sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ kɛkɛ sĩiyɔ biruɔ kpɑ ɑ mɑn yɑrɑ tɑbu sĩɑn di, domi bɑ mɑn mɛɛrɑ kuɑwɑ mi.
Yen dɔmɑ te, tɑɑ bi, bu swĩɑ ɡem ɡem. Mɑ bɑ sinɑ boko nɛnusi u kɑ yɔ̃ win tɑbu kɛkɛ sɔɔ u wuswɑɑ tĩi Siriɡibun tɑbu sɑnsɑnin berɑ ɡiɑ. Mɑ win yɛm mu wĩɑ kɛkɛ ye sɔɔ. Yen yokɑ mɑ u ɡu.
Ye sɔ̃ɔ u duɔ, yerɑ ɡoo u ɡbɑ̃rɑ Isirelibɑn sɑnsɑniɔ u nɛɛ, bɑɑwure u wuro win yɛnuɔ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ sinɑ boko Akɑbu u kɑ ɡu. Mɑ bɑ kɑ win ɡoru nɑ Sɑmɑriɔ bɑ sikuɑ.
Ye bɑ win tɑbu kɛkɛ ye woburumɔ Sɑmɑrin yɛruɔ, yerɑ bɔ̃nu nɑ, nu win yɛm dɑburɑ. Mɑ kurɔ tɑnɔbɑ nɑ bɑ woburɑ mi, nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u rɑɑ ɡeruɑ.
Ye Akɑbu u kuɑn sukum kɑ dii te u bɑnɑ kɑ suunu donnu, kɑ wuu si u bɑnɑ kpuron ɡɑri yi wɑ̃ɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑmbun fɑɑɡin tireru sɔɔ.
Bɑ Akɑbu sikuɑ win bɑɑbɑbɑn sikɑɔ. Mɑ win bii Akɑsiɑ u bɑndu di.
Yosɑfɑti u kuɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko
Akɑbu Isirelibɑn sinɑ bokon bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ nnɛse sɔɔrɑ Yosɑfɑti u bɑndu di Yudɑɔ.
Yosɑfɑti wi, u mɔwɑ wɔ̃ɔ tɛnɑ kɑ nɔɔbu sɑnɑm mɛ u bɑn te di. Mɑ u kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ yɛndɑ nɔɔbu bɑndu sɔɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Win mɛron yĩsirɑ Asubɑ Silikin bii.
U kuɑ ye yɑ Yinni Gusunɔ wɛ̃re. Win tundo Asɑn yirɑ u swĩi mɑm mɑm.
Adɑmɑ u ǹ ɡunɡunu mi bɑ rɑ bũu yɑ̃kuru ko kɔsuke. U derɑ tɔmbɑ ben yɑ̃kunu mɔ̀ mi, mɑ bɑ turɑre dɔ̃ɔ dokemɔ.
Mɛyɑ mɑɑ bɔri yɛndɑ wɑ̃ɑ wi kɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑ bokon suunu sɔɔ.
Ye Yosɑfɑti u kuɑn sukum kɑ wɔruɡɔɔ te u sɔ̃ɔsi tɑbu sɔɔ, ye kpuron ɡɑri yi yoruɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑmbun fɑɑɡin tireru sɔɔ,
kɑ nɡe mɛ u kurɔ tɑnɔ be bɑ tie sɑɑ win tundo Asɑn wɑɑtin di ɡirɑ, be bɑ ɡɔsɑ bɑ n kɑ sɑkɑrɑru mɔ̀ ben sɑ̃ɑrun swɑɑ sɔɔ.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Edɔmubɑ bɑ ǹ sunɔ mɔ. Adɑmɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko u ɡoo yi mi, u n kɑ sɑ̃ɑ ben wiruɡii.
Yosɑfɑti u ɡoo nimkusu dɑ̃kɑ si bɑ ko n dɑ kɑ wurɑ kɑso de Ofiriɔ. Adɑmɑ su ku rɑ turi mi, su rɑ kɔsirewɑ swɑɑɔ, wuu ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Ɛsioni Gebɛɛɔ.
Yerɑ Akɑsiɑ Akɑbun bii u Yosɑfɑti sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ kĩ wunɛn sɔm kowobu kɑ nɛɡibu bɑ n dɑ de sɑnnu? Mɑ Yosɑfɑti u yinɑ.
Yen biruwɑ Yosɑfɑti u kpunɑ u ɡu. Mɑ bɑ nùn sikuɑ win bɑɑbɑbɑn sikɑɔ Dɑfidin wuuɔ. Mɑ win bii Yorɑmu u bɑndu kɔsire kuɑ.
Akɑsiɑ u kuɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko
Akɑsiɑ, Akɑbun bii u bɑndu di Isirelibɑ sɔɔ Sɑmɑriɔ, Yosɑfɑti Yudɑbɑn sinɑ bokon bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ yiruse sɔɔ. Mɑ Akɑsiɑ wi, u kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ yiru bɑndu sɔɔ.
Win bɑn te sɔɔ, kɔ̃sɑ u kuɑ Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ. Win tundo kɑ win mɛron yirɑ u swĩi, kɑ sere mɑɑ Yeroboɑmu Nɛbɑtin biiɡiɑ, wi u Isirelibɑ doke torɑru sɔɔ.
Bũu wi bɑ mɔ̀ Bɑɑli wiyɑ u rɑ yiire u n sɑ̃ɑmɔ. Mɑ u Yinni Gusunɔn mɔru seeyɑ nɡe mɛ win tundo u rɑɑ kuɑ.
